title: QUIC RFC 9000 Server Retry Token Validation Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home execution for listener Retry-token validation, invalid-token discard, valid-token admission, Release build, generated coverage triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers server-side Retry-token replay validation for Initial packets whose destination connection ID matches the listener-issued Retry source connection ID.
expected_result: The listener discards replay candidates with wrong or missing expected Retry tokens without admitting the connection, records token validation failure evidence, validates and records valid Retry tokens, and allows the server handshake bootstrap path to proceed only after validation succeeds.
procedure: Run the focused S8P1P3 server Retry-token validation requirement-home filter.
preconditions: Retry bootstrap is enabled on the listener host.
A Retry packet has already been issued so the listener has an expected Retry token.
Persistent NEW_TOKEN validation remains outside this verification scope.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim persistent NEW_TOKEN validation, token expiration, observer-linkability, or public token cache behavior.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The Release build passed with zero warnings, the focused S8P1P3 server Retry-token validation filter passed 8/8, the full no-build solution test suite passed 3723/3723, regenerated triage reached trace_clean for the selected requirements, and SpecTrace core validation passed for 343 JSON artifacts.
